privacyConsent.title: Privacy and cookie settings
privacyConsent.message: This site uses Google tags for measurement. While analytics storage is denied, Google may still receive limited cookieless signals. Allowing analytics enables analytics storage.
privacyConsent.details: When analytics storage is denied, Google tags may send cookieless measurement signals, including page context and consent status. When granted, analytics cookies may be used. Advertising-related consent remains denied. Other tags in a Tag Manager container may have separate behavior depending on administrator configuration.
privacyConsent.analyticsHelp: Your choice is saved in this browser and can be changed at any time.
